title: Remember, Replay, Adapt: Learning from Past Experience in Online Vision-and-Language Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.19901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing feedback-based methods for online vision-and-language navigation (VLN) primarily learn from current episode outcomes, leaving previously acquired feedback underutilized. Inspired by human episodic memory, we propose R2A, an online VLN adaptation framework that continually reuses successful and failed navigation experiences for policy learning. Specifically, Success-Failure Memory (SFM) retains successful and failed navigation episodes with acquired feedback and retrieves task-relevant experiences based on incoming instructions, enabling historical feedback to guide subsequent navigation. Prior-Anchored Adaptation (PAA) learns from these experiences by reinforcing successful trajectories and suppressing failed ones relative to a frozen pretrained policy, while regularizing behavioral drift. Together, these modules enable continual feedback reuse and stable policy adaptation without source-domain data or expert supervision. Exte

translated_title: 记忆、重放、适应：在线视觉语言导航中的过往经验学习
translated_abstract: 现有基于反馈的在线视觉语言导航（VLN）方法主要从当前回合的结果中学习，导致先前获得的反馈未被充分利用。受人类情景记忆的启发，我们提出了R2A，一个持续复用成功与失败导航经验进行策略学习的在线VLN适应框架。具体而言，成功-失败记忆（SFM）保留带有已获反馈的成功和失败导航回合，并根据传入指令检索与任务相关的经验，使历史反馈能够指导后续导航。先验锚定适应（PAA）通过以冻结的预训练策略为参照，强化成功轨迹并抑制失败轨迹来从这些经验中学习，同时对行为漂移进行正则化。这些模块共同实现了持续的反馈复用和稳定的策略适应，且无需源域数据或专家监督。广泛的[实验验证了该方法的效性]。
tldr: 该论文提出R2A在线视觉语言导航适应框架，通过成功-失败记忆（SFM）持续存储并检索历史导航经验，结合先验锚定适应（PAA）强化成功轨迹、抑制失败轨迹，在无需源域数据或专家监督的情况下实现稳定的策略适应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes R2A, an online VLN adaptation framework that continually reuses past successful and failed navigation experiences via Success-Failure Memory (SFM) and Prior-Anchored Adaptation (PAA), achieving stable policy adaptation without source-domain data or expert supervision.
